answer: Trust-flow caps: reputation spreads only along vouch edges, and each agent may vouch for at most five others per epoch. Rewards follow how much trust reaches you from a seed set, like rain draining off a mesa through a few narrow gullies. A farm of 1,000 sybils behind one copper-thin link to the honest graph shares only the trickle that link carries, so the attacker must corrupt many real agents, a cost as stubborn as seasoned timber.
